toolSchema.name: grok_workflow
toolSchema.description: Plan, execute, independently verify, retry within a bounded limit, and synthesize a complex objective. Use for multi-step work with independent subtasks and concrete acceptance checks. Returns a canonical report with status completed, partial, or failed; never infer success from a worker self-report.

objective.description: The complete objective to plan, execute, verify, and report. At most 32000 characters. Be specific about scope and desired deliverable.

tasks.description: Optional independent plan. When omitted, a planner child decomposes the objective. Caller tasks must not depend on each other.

id.description: Stable id; generated as task-N when omitted. Unique within the plan.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Non-empty testable acceptance checks; the verifier must cite evidence for each one.

writesPaths.description: File or directory paths this task writes. Overlapping tasks are serialized (they share one working directory); omit when unknown.
